data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each other fisher: will you choose 18, 10, or another exact amount, and does it depend on others? Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed and long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Fellow recruiters, seek individual opt-ins.
